name: Query Uniprot
description: Query the UniProt REST API using either natural language or a direct endpoint.
detailed_description: Query the UniProt REST API using either natural language or a direct endpoint.
when_to_use: When you need query uniprot analysis

parameters.prompt: [Required] Natural language query about proteins (e.g., "Find information about human insulin") (str)
parameters.endpoint: [Optional] Full or partial UniProt API endpoint URL to query directly (e.g., 'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P01308')
parameters.max_results: [Optional] Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)
